values.note: Forest Service fee table: single site $20/night, single with electric hook-up $25, double site $40, double with electric $45, group site $40. Day use $3 per vehicle per day ($30 annual).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bark-camp-recreation-area ('Single Site: $20 per night', 'Single Site with electric hook-up: $25 per night', 'Group Site $40 per night', 'Double Site: $40 per night', 'Double Site with electric hook-up: $45 per night', '$5 electric hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The campground is open from the 3rd Saturday in May through the last Saturday in September (May 16 - September 26 in 2026); the day-use area is open year-round.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bark-camp-recreation-area (Seasons of Use: 'The campground is open from the 3rd Saturday in May through the last Saturday in September. The day use recreation area is open year-round.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bath houses with hot showers and flush toilets only during the campground season. The page contradicts itself on drinking water ('Potable water is not available at this site' beside 'Water is not available when the campground is closed for the season'), so potable water is left unknown.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/bark-camp-recreation-area ('Bath houses with hot showers and flush toilets available only during the campground open season'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: First-come, first-served only: 'Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site.' On site you may be able to pay through the Recreation.gov app's Scan and Pay.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158445 (Overview: 'This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Pass provides a 50% discount to base campsite fee (not hook ups) and the day use fee. No other America the Beautiful Interagency passes are valid at this site.'

note: USFS campground set back in the woods near Bark Camp Lake.  Some campsites are close to the lake but view is likely blocked by trees.  --AWH
summary: Confirmed on the Forest Service page and rec.gov: first-come only (derived -> manual), $20 single to $45 double-electric, season 3rd Sat in May - last Sat in Sept, hot showers/flush toilets, Senior/Access pass 50% off the base fee (now verified for this campground). Note trimmed of the redundant RV Life and FCFS lines (AWH text kept verbatim). Not stated: site count, electric amperage, max rig length, potable water (page contradicts itself).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (operator claim differs; waterfront not changed): the Forest Service page describes 'a seasonal campground ... situated beside a 45-acre lake' with a shoreline trail circling it, while the entry is 'not waterfront' and the --AWH note says sites near the lake likely have the view blocked by trees.
